title: Neurotrauma system.
bodyText: The department of health shall develop, lead, administer, coordinate, monitor, evaluate, and set direction for a comprehensive system to support and provide services for survivors of neurotrauma injuries.
bodyHtml: [§321H-2]  Neurotrauma system.  The department of health shall develop, lead, administer, coordinate, monitor, evaluate, and set direction for a comprehensive system to support and provide services for survivors of neurotrauma injuries. [L 2002, c 160, pt of §2]
